items.description: Credential metadata only; no digest or plaintext.

post.description: Durably store canonical messages and queue deliveries. Prefer: return=minimal returns a compact acceptance receipt; it is not delivery or execution confirmation. Replay the same input and idempotency key without Prefer to retrieve the full result without resending.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Optional return=minimal; full SendResult remains the default.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: With stream=1, summary=1 omits event data while preserving current authorization, metadata and replay cursors, except canonical message.created bodies for an optional selected conversation_id. Full events remain the default.

parameters.name: conversation_id
parameters.description: With stream=1 and summary=1, include canonical message.created data only for this readable conversation. All other event payloads remain null. This never grants access or filters out other visible event metadata.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after the last complete event. Takes precedence over the initial after query during EventSource reconnection.
